gates.name: signed_contract_and_trust
gates.evidence: Exact Ed25519 artifacts bind issuer/key, tenant, Policy ID, generation, validity, source/semantic digests and a closed compatibility tuple; unknown, malformed, mutated, expired and trust-drift inputs deny without activation.

gates.name: reviewable_lifecycle
gates.evidence: Draft, validate, deterministic semantic Diff, simulate, exact Owner approval, stage, activate, supersede, rollout-confirm, retire and revoke are ordered durable transitions; approval binds artifact, Diff, simulation, generation, validity and explicit widening consent.

gates.name: use_fallback_and_recovery
gates.evidence: Only AAS-002 activates and validates use; receipts are authenticated and hash-chained; mixed generations, partial rollout, active revoke and post-activation lifecycle persistence failure freeze without implicit fallback or a duplicate activation.

gates.name: adversarial_regression_evidence
gates.evidence: Lifecycle tests cover unsigned, signature mutation, unknown trust, tenant/time/compatibility errors, replay, skipped stages, approval substitution, unapproved widening, trust drift, expiry, mixed use, partial rollout, revoke, convergence failure and record/receipt tamper.

fullInstallSmoke.reason: The lifecycle is a separate default-off management-plane contract. The stock runtime Docker closure, Compose and installer bytes are unchanged, so repeating the completed AAS-035 install smoke would violate the evidence-gated smoke rule.

nonClaims: No production signer, HSM, PKI, independently managed trust root, transparency log or rollback-resistant storage was tested or enabled.
No hostile-host resistance, distributed consensus, rollout quorum, production IAM/tenant source or live provider was tested or claimed.
The stock runtime exposes no lifecycle activation API, and unsupported widened static Policy semantics remain denied even with explicit lifecycle approval.
No push, pull request, merge, tag, release, publication, production deployment, live credential or external-system action.
